root_cause_of_failures: USB port 3-2 in a continuous disconnect/reconnect crash loop (dmesg: 'device not accepting address', error -71) — a real electrical/physical fault, likely a hub or port, taking both cameras plugged through it down together. Requires physical inspection at the kiosk; not fixable remotely.
note: Which two specific device-index cameras fail has been observed to shift slightly between runs (locker_3/locker_4 here vs. an earlier locker_2/face split observed during log review), consistent with USB device renumbering on each disconnect/reconnect cycle from the same underlying fault, not two independent problems.
